leads.name: Wat Aham banyan pair (Bodhi/Banyan), Luang Prabang
leads.species: Banyan / Bodhi fig (Ficus sp., species not settled by any source)
leads.location: Wat Aham, next to Wat Visounnarath, old town peninsula (about 19.89, 102.13); no sourced coordinate, not placed
leads.reason: Verify pass 2026-11-02: tourismluangprabang.org says a former king planted saplings from India in the 1950s (about 70 years, not ancient, and the sentence may belong to the neighbouring temple); luangprabang-laos.com says two large banyans stand there but gives no age; travel blogs call them centuries-old on the spirit legend (not a source). Conflicting age, no coordinate, species unconfirmed. Large, venerated, free to see from the street; revisit with a GPS fix or a dated photo and an age source.

leads.name: Wat Visounnarath (Wat Visoun) Bodhi tree, Luang Prabang
leads.location: Wat Visounnarath, old town (about 19.8905, 102.1370); no sourced coordinate
leads.reason: Verify pass 2026-11-02: British Library EAP archive records a Bodhi sapling brought from India and planted at Vat Vixunnarat on 26 Oct 1968 (and a Vat Mai Bodhi on 12 Oct 1955). Planted within living memory, not ancient. Possibly the same trees as the Wat Aham 1950s claim; unresolved. Fee for the temple site.
